title: patch_file repeatedly failed on fix_signal.skill.md Complete phase
description: Three patch_file calls on fix_signal.skill.md returned 'old_string not found' despite content being confirmed via grep and re-read. The first patch (Phase 1 no-signal exit) succeeded, but two subsequent patches on the Complete phase failed. Fallback to write_file was used correctly, but patch_file failures were recorded as tool errors causing tool-errors rubric to fail.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file fails on files recently modified by a prior patch_file call in the same run. The exact-string matching may be affected by line-ending normalization differences between the first write and subsequent reads.
